title: Gitanjali (Song Offerings): A Collection of Prose Translations Made by the Author from the Original Bengali

publication.publisher_or_container: The India Society, London (later Macmillan & Co.)

verification.verification_notes: Bengali original published 4 August 1910; English prose translation first published by the India Society in November 1912 and by Macmillan in 1913; awarded the 1913 Nobel Prize in Literature. Confirmed via Project Gutenberg, Britannica, and the Nobel Prize archive. The English is the author's own radical rewriting, not a literal translation.

limitations: The English prose version omits, reorders, and fuses Bengali poems and cannot stand in for the original Bengali; analysis here does not rely on the English wording alone.

copyright.notes: English Gitanjali (1912) is in the public domain in the USA; no text is reproduced in this dossier regardless.
